companies.name: BP p.l.c.
companies.description: BP p.l.c. is an integrated energy company that produces and refines crude oil and natural gas, markets fuels and lubricants to commercial and retail customers, trades energy commodities, and invests in renewable energy and lower‑carbon fuels. They typically serve industrial and commercial energy buyers as well as retail fuel customers, and they claim to be diversifying their portfolio by expanding wind, biofuels, hydrogen and electric‑vehicle charging offerings alongside traditional petroleum operations.

companies.name: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Inc. (Popeyes)
companies.description: Popeyes is a quick-service restaurant chain that specializes in Southern-style chicken and seafood dishes. Their typical customers are individuals and families looking for a convenient and affordable dining option. Popeyes differentiates itself through its unique blend of Cajun and Creole flavors, as well as its famous buttermilk biscuits. They also market themselves as offering a "Louisiana Fast" dining experience, emphasizing the authentic and flavorful nature of their menu items.

companies.name: Siemens AG
companies.description: Siemens AG is a global technology company that focuses on electrification, automation, and digitalization. Their products and services range from power generation and distribution to medical imaging and industrial automation. Their typical customers include energy providers, manufacturers, healthcare institutions, and infrastructure companies. Siemens differentiates itself through its focus on innovation, sustainability, and providing comprehensive solutions for their customers' needs.

companies.name: Google
companies.description: Google is a multinational technology company that specializes in internet-related products and services. Its offerings include online advertising technologies, search engine, cloud computing, software, and hardware. Google's typical customers include consumers, businesses, advertisers, and publishers who use its various products and services for different reasons. Google positions itself as a company that offers innovative and user-friendly technology solutions that aim to make the world's information accessible and useful.

companies.name: Republic Services, Inc.
companies.description: Republic Services provides integrated non-hazardous solid waste collection, transportation, recycling, and disposal services for municipal, commercial, industrial, multifamily, and residential customers and emphasizes a broad operational network and investments in recycling and landfill-gas-to-energy infrastructure.

companies.name: Kentucky Farm Bureau Mutual Insurance Company
Wehr Constructors, Inc.
companies.description: Wehr Constructors, Inc. is a construction manager and general contractor serving institutional and organizational clients (healthcare, education, commercial, government, religious/non-profit, industrial) that markets itself as community-focused and culture-driven, emphasizing teamwork, faith, character, relationship-building, professional project delivery, and safety.

companies.name: J. A. Street & Associates
companies.description: J. A. Street & Associates is a general contracting firm specializing in design-build and construction management for commercial, industrial, and institutional clients. They serve businesses such as retailers, manufacturers, institutional owners, and developers and claim to differentiate through an integrated, single-source project delivery model and a collaborative team approach.

companies.name: Insight Risk Management
companies.description: Insight Risk Management is an independent insurance agency and broker offering commercial and personal insurance placement, employee benefits, surety bonds, and risk management services to business and consumer clients. They emphasize long-standing operation, a team of experienced insurance and surety professionals, and providing multiple coverage options and risk-management advice. Their primary focus is brokering insurance solutions and managing client risk exposures.

companies.name: Ruggles Sign Company
companies.description: Ruggles Sign Company manufactures custom signs and manages end-to-end signage programs for business clients, focusing on design, project management, fabrication, installation, rebranding, and maintenance; they emphasize family ownership, long-term experience, personalized service, and the ability to deliver regional to global signage programs.

companies.name: Wilson Nurseries Inc
companies.description: Wilson Nurseries Inc is a landscape supply company offering a wide range of nursery stock, hardgoods, and accessories such as evergreens, grasses, perennials, shrubs, and natural stone. They also provide delivery services to yards and jobsites, as well as cater to contractors looking for quality plants and materials. Their typical customers include landscapers, contractors, and homeowners looking to enhance their outdoor spaces. Wilson Nurseries Inc claims to differentiate itself through its commitment to quality, convenience, and availability, as well as its extensive knowledge of plant information and its display gardens.

companies.name: ABG Caulking & Waterproofing of Morristown Inc.
MP Kelly Design & Construction
companies.description: MP Kelly Design & Construction designs and constructs customized industrial and commercial buildings for business clients. They provide pre-construction consulting, design-build, general contracting and construction management services, with specialized capabilities in tilt-up construction and heavy industrial foundations, and emphasize owner/principal involvement and extensive project experience.

companies.name: The Rock, LLC
companies.description: THE ROCK is a family-owned masonry contractor offering brick, stone, and block construction and design/build services to commercial builders, developers, and general contractors. They emphasize decades of industry experience and capability across veneer, structural masonry (CMU), cast stone and architectural detailing for building projects.

companies.name: Cass Concrete
companies.description: Cass Concrete provides on-site concrete construction and related services for commercial, industrial, and multi-family housing projects. They offer Gypcrete underlayment and a range of concrete work—foundations, structural renovations, FF & FL floor systems, demolition, paving, sidewalks, curbs, walls, columns, and piers—and position themselves around precision, safety, and efficiency while supporting projects from consultation to completion.

companies.name: Associated Railroad Contrs Inc
companies.description: Associated Railroad Contractors Inc. offers design and build services, new construction, maintenance, and material and equipment for sale to the railroad industry. Their typical customers are railroad companies, transit agencies, and other organizations involved in the construction and maintenance of rail infrastructure. Associated Railroad Contractors Inc. positions itself as a reliable and experienced partner in the railroad industry, emphasizing their expertise, quality of work, and dedication to meeting their customers' needs.

companies.name: Ez Construction
companies.description: E-Z Construction provides design-build site development and concrete construction services for commercial, industrial, and public-sector clients, specializing in park infrastructure, parking and storm systems, and concrete structures. They target manufacturing, commercial, and public-works customers and position themselves as a value-engineered, efficiency-focused contractor with decades of experience and a knowledgeable, certified staff.

companies.name: Kentucky Associated General Contractors Self Insurers' Fund
Chas. H. Bilz Insurance Agency, Inc.
Enviro-Tec Services
companies.description: Enviro-Tec Services provides industrial fabrication and mechanical contracting services to business clients such as manufacturers and commercial operators. They position themselves as industrial fabricators and mechanical contractors and invite direct contact for project needs and inquiries.

companies.name: Little Creek Construction, LLC
companies.description: Little Creek Construction, LLC provides residential construction services specializing in home additions and exterior remodeling for homeowners. They position themselves as a family-owned, licensed contractor with experienced leadership that uses quality materials and offers responsive, personalized service. Primary services include garage, room and sunroom additions, decks, patios, and fence construction.

companies.name: Do It Best
companies.description: Do It Best is a member-owned hardware, lumber and building materials cooperative that supplies and retails a broad assortment of tools, building materials, paint, plumbing, lawn & garden, and outdoor living products to consumers and member retail stores; they highlight cooperative membership, nationwide member locations, store-level services and same-day online order pickup.

companies.name: The King's Helper
companies.description: The King's Helper provides plumbing and HVAC repair, maintenance, and emergency response services to residential and small property customers and positions themselves as a dependable, long-established partner that honors commitments and responds when problems arise.

companies.name: Nally & Gibson Georgetown Inc
companies.description: Nally & Gibson Georgetown Inc operates a limestone quarry and supplies crushed limestone and other construction aggregates, and provides paving services. They serve construction and paving contractors and other businesses needing aggregate materials. They position themselves as a long-established, vertically integrated supplier with on-site quarrying and paving capabilities.

companies.name: A G C Of Kentucky Inc
Hall and Clark Insurance Agency, Inc.
Andys Mirror Glass
companies.description: Andys Mirror Glass provides commercial and residential glass and glazing services, including glass replacement, storefronts and entrances, curtainwall, mirrors, windows, doors, showers, and tabletops. They serve both residential customers and commercial clients and market themselves as a locally owned hometown glazing contractor with over 70 years of history and availability when needed, offering products at competitive prices.

companies.name: Monarch Construction
companies.description: Monarch Construction is an independent general contractor focused on commercial and institutional building projects. They offer general contracting, design/build delivery, self-performed concrete construction, and pre-construction services for public and private owners, educational institutions, healthcare, and industrial clients. They emphasize safety and performance ratings, single-point responsibility through design/build, and in-house concrete capabilities.

companies.name: W B Fosson & Sons Inc
companies.description: W B Fosson & Sons Inc are a construction firm offering general contracting, construction management, mechanical contracting, design services, and design-build delivery for commercial, institutional, healthcare, education, and industrial clients; they emphasize decades of experience, a collaborative hands-on project management approach, and delivering projects on schedule and on budget.

companies.name: Potter General Contracting, LLC
companies.description: Potter General Contracting provides commercial construction services focused on design-build and tenant improvement projects for business and institutional clients, including retail build-outs, medical and office facilities, restaurants, manufacturing facilities, and institutional projects. They emphasize managing projects from concept to completion and claim to differentiate by giving clients access to a cloud-based construction app for real-time project visibility and document handling.

companies.name: Smith-Manus Surety Bonds
companies.description: Smith-Manus Surety Bonds brokers and places surety bonds and designs surety programs for businesses in industries such as construction, mining, oil and gas, development, waste, and environmental remediation. They serve business customers that need performance, payment, license/permit, and federal contracting bonds, and they market themselves as an experienced, industry-focused surety partner with nationwide reach and a partnership with a major broker.
